text:
Camila Reyes: Quick sync in-thread on analyst briefing logistics for the benchmark report. Need: attendee list, agenda, speakers (methodology vs GTM narrative), and who handles Q&A. Goal is to lock by EOD so we can send calendar + pre-reads.

Ben Carter: +1. Also need to decide whether we do 30 or 45 min. The invite draft currently says 45 w/ 10 min Q&A.

Talia Benson: I can run point on scheduling + invite. Can someone confirm which analysts are “priority 1” vs “nice to have”? I’m seeing multiple lists in Drive.

Soojin Lee: Re: agenda, suggest we keep it tight and avoid “vendor pitch.” Analysts want market framing + methodology credibility + what’s new in product surface (API/Dedicated/Private).

Ethan Wallace: Draft agenda (45 min):
1) 0–5: intro + why latency/$ (Camila)
2) 5–12: market framing + what we measured + what we didn’t (Soojin)
3) 12–27: methodology deep dive (Jonas or Claire) incl. workloads, concurrency, warmup/caching policy, regions, variance / CI language
4) 27–35: headline findings (Ethan) — w/ caveats + how to interpret
5) 35–41: “what this means for engineering teams” + CTAs (Jordan)
6) 41–45: open Q&A (all)

Jonas Weber: I’m happy to present methodology, but I’d like Claire to cover the variance/QA/rerun policy section since she’s been closest to the actual runbooks + triage.

Claire Dubois: Can do. If we split it, I can take 5 min on:
- run-to-run variance summary
- rerun triggers + anomaly triage
- guardrails so we didn’t impact prod SLOs
We should be super explicit on “comparability constraints” (same harness/config, fixed windows, region-by-region).

Sana Farid: +1 and pls give me 24h to sanity check the wording on confidence intervals vs “variance bands” so we don’t overstate statistical rigor. We can say “run-to-run variability” + “repeat runs across windows” and show the band chart.

Jordan Blake: For the “what it means”/CTA segment, I can do it but I want Markus to be the “technical closer” if they ask “how do I reproduce?” or “how do you price latency/$?”

Markus Klein: Yep. I can be in the room for Q&A and jump in on:
- reproduction steps / benchmark-lab
- region routing headers (OpenAI compat)
- how customers should map their workload to our distributions
Also: make sure we have a slide that clearly says “results are not a guarantee” and “your mileage will vary.”

Wei Chen: On pre-reads: I can package a short “methodology appendix” PDF + the landing page preview link. Better than sending the full draft report.

Camila Reyes: Love the split:
- Camila: intro + positioning
- Soojin: market narrative + how to talk about latency/$
- Jonas + Claire: methodology + QA/variance
- Ethan: findings walkthrough
- Jordan (+ Markus on deck): implications/CTA + Q&A

Ben Carter: Attendee list—here’s my draft Priority 1 (based on past coverage + who asked about inference economics):
- Tier-1 Cloud/AI infra analysts (3)
- DevTools/Platform analysts (2)
- EU analyst who cares about data residency (1)
Priority 2:
- ML ops generalists (2)
- “AI apps” folks (1)
I’ll drop names in the invite doc, but posting here feels weird. :grimacing:

Talia Benson: Works—send me the list in DM or link the sheet. For logistics, what timezone(s)? If we do two sessions (NA-friendly + EMEA-friendly) we’ll get better turnout.

Lukas Meyer: Please do one EMEA-friendly slot. Analysts in London/Berlin won’t join a late PT call. Also: we need one slide that clearly separates EU region results and data residency wording so it doesn’t get conflated with “global routing.”

Soojin Lee: Agree. Also recommend we start with 2–3 “rules of engagement”:
- we’ll share methodology + constraints
- we won’t comment on competitor private data
- we’ll follow up for deep dives

Ethan Wallace: Re: pre-reads, suggest:
1) 1-pager: “What is latency/$ and how computed”
2) Topline charts (2 slides) with disclaimers
3) methodology appendix excerpt
Anything more and they won’t read.

Claire Dubois: For Q&A, can we prep answers to:
- “how did you price GPUs / cost model?”
- “are results repeatable week-to-week?”
- “did you tune per model?”
- “how do you handle caching?”
- “why these sequence lengths?”
I can send a short Q&A doc.

Ben Carter: +1. Also they always ask: “Is this just marketing?” We should proactively say: internal validation, reruns, and public table build is deterministic/sanitized.

Sana Farid: If we show any band/variance chart, we should be clear on what it is (e.g., p50/p95 across N runs) and what it’s not (formal population CI). I’ll edit the speaker notes.

Camila Reyes: Timing: let’s keep it 45 w/ 10 min Q&A (so really 35 content). If we run over, we can offer follow-up 1:1.

Talia Benson: Action items:
- Ben: finalize analyst list + 2 proposed timeslots
- Wei: package pre-reads + landing page preview link
- Ethan: turn agenda into slide order + owner per section
- Jonas/Claire/Sana: confirm methodology slides + Q&A prep
- Jordan/Markus/Lukas: review for “field-safe” claims + EU/data residency language

Jordan Blake: On claims: pls align with the external claims guidelines (no absolute “best,” use “in our tests,” mention configuration + regions). I don’t want to walk anything back in follow-ups.

Soojin Lee: I’ll add a “do/don’t” slide at the end as a backup if the conversation goes sideways (e.g., competitor bait).

Markus Klein: Also: can we have a backup plan if someone asks for raw logs? The answer needs to be consistent: we can share sanitized tables + reproduction harness, but not per-request traces.

Camila Reyes: Yes. That’s the line.

Ben Carter: I’ll update the invite to include:
- 45 min briefing
- pre-reads link
- speakers list
- note: “we’ll reserve time for deep dive Q&A”
Will post link here once ready.

Talia Benson: Great—once I have the final list + times, I’ll send calendar holds today.

Wei Chen: Pre-read pack draft will be in Drive in ~2 hours. I’ll drop the link here.

Ethan Wallace: I’ll build a “speaker handoff” version of the deck (clear slide ownership + transitions) so it doesn’t feel chaotic.

Camila Reyes: Thanks all. Let’s aim to do a 15-min rehearsal tomorrow (same speakers) to make sure we don’t overrun + disclaimers land cleanly.
